title: Unconfoundedness as an Information Constraint
abstract: arXiv:2611.03550v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper provides an information-theoretic characterization of unconfoundedness within a general class of models allowing for endogenous selection. We impose a conditional mutual information (CMI) restriction requiring that the information about treatment contained in a potential outcome, conditional on covariates, does not exceed that contained in its latent heterogeneity. Under the maintained model conditions, this restriction is equivalent to a multiplicative factorization of treatment probabilities into separate functions of latent heterogeneity and covariates. Although the CMI restriction permits endogenous selection, sufficiently rich variation in treatment probabilities across covariate values makes it equivalent to unconfoundedness for the corresponding potential outcome. For binary treatments, any nonconstant propensity score suffices; for multiple treatments, a full-rank condition on the second-moment matrix of the propensity

translated_title: 无混杂性作为一种信息约束
translated_abstract: 本文在允许内生选择的一类广义模型中，对无混杂性进行了信息论刻画。我们施加了一个条件互信息（CMI）约束，要求潜在结果中所包含的处理信息（在给定协变量的条件下）不超过其潜在异质性中所包含的信息。在所维持的模型条件下，该约束等价于处理概率的乘法分解，即分解为潜在异质性和协变量各自独立的函数。尽管CMI约束允许内生选择的存在，但只要处理概率在协变量取值上具有足够丰富的变化，该约束对于相应的潜在结果而言就等价于无混杂性。对于二元处理，任何非常数的倾向得分即可满足该条件；对于多重处理，则只需倾向得分二阶矩矩阵满足满秩条件。
tldr: 本文提出用条件互信息（CMI）这一信息论约束来刻画无混杂性假设，证明在允许内生选择的模型中，该约束配合处理概率随协变量的充分变化即可等价于无混杂性。
